title: Check if compaction config missing in opencode.json causes overflow
description: Verify whether the compaction config in opencode.json specifies minimum/target token thresholds. If config is missing or uses defaults that don't account for memory injection size, compaction could leave context right at the edge → memory push → threshold exceeded → second compaction.

title: Verify compaction.ts messages.transform trigger during compaction process
description: Check if compaction.ts messages.transform handler fires during the compaction process itself. If compaction triggers another system.transform → memory injection → overflow, this could be a loop.

title: Analyze memory-hooks.ts: system.transform + session.idle interaction with compaction
description: Investigate how memory-hooks.ts system.transform pushes memory into context (via pendingMemoryBlock) and how session.idle triggers compaction. Check if the injected memory content pushes token count over the compaction threshold right after compaction completes.

title: Investigation: Double compaction after session idle
description: Goal: Find root cause of double compaction trigger in OpenCode (custom compaction agent + memory-hooks plugin). Hypothesis: memory-hooks.ts memory inject via system.transform pushes context over limit after compaction → LLM returns compact → second compaction create.
